title: Lighthouse cohorts + Experimentation Lab for Private/VPC quarterly rollout
creator: Daniel Morris
description: Run a structured quarterly program that combines a small set of "lighthouse" customer cohorts with an internal Experimentation Lab to validate upgrade, rollback, and compatibility flows for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. Goal: reduce upgrade risk for enterprise tenants by proving operational runbooks, tenant-side migration APIs, and a compatibility verifier before wider tranche rollouts. This ticket defines scope, success metrics, required engineering work, and the stakeholder cadence for Q1 planning and execution.
acceptance_criteria: Onboard at least 3 lighthouse customers representing hybrid, air-gapped, and VPC profiles and complete a full upgrade cycle in the lab
Automated manifest compatibility verifier runs against customer model/config permutations with <2% false-positive rate on a held-out sample
Documented rollback runbook with timed rollback drill showing <5 minute rollback-to-safe-state for at least 2 cohorts
Telemetry and dashboard signals (latency, tail-error, KV cache miss rate, and retry budget) wired to Console and a Datadog dashboard for the cohorts
Tenant migration API v1 implemented and exercised by at least one customer during the lab

decisions: Use a dual-path rollout: Experimentation Lab (internal) -> Lighthouse cohorts (opt-in customers) -> Tranche rollout. This preserves a safety net while collecting real telemetry.
Adopt the manifest compatibility verifier as a gating signal but not the single source of truth for rollbacks. Operator review remains required for initial tranches.
Implement a 'tethered upgrade' window: an automated, time-limited upgrade that can be programmatically reverted. Rationale: reduce blast radius and enable measurable rollback SLAs.
Keep schema migration for stateful components as a manual opt-in for Q1; re-evaluate for Q2 after two successful lighthouse upgrades.
risks: Limited customer participation could delay validation; mitigation: offer dedicated engineering hours and credits to participants.
Compatibility verifier false negatives could allow a failing manifest to upgrade; mitigation: threshold-based gating + post-upgrade health checks and automatic rollback hooks.
Operational burden on SRE for the tethered upgrades during Q1; mitigation: schedule low-traffic nights and automate teardown steps.
Security/KMS integration delays from customer side; mitigation: early security template and shared onboarding checklist.

rollout_plan: Week 1-2: internal Experimentation Lab runs with synthetic tenants. Week 3: dry-run with a non-critical lighthouse customer in sandbox. Week 4: live tethered upgrade with first lighthouse cohort. Post-upgrade: 7-day monitoring window, rollback drills on day 2 and day 5. If metrics exceed failure thresholds, trigger tranche halt and incident retro.
